Establish comparable local production browser evidence, not a hosted latency claim.

Affected existing cache/runtime source-contract tests only when their concrete interface changes

readContract.population: Anonymous published tenant home, product and collection index; normal synthetic store26 collections/product2variants; existing private preview remains capability-gated
readContract.representation: Same StoreModel, three navigation locations and existing Liquid render; no additional fields or business authority
readContract.reuse: React cache request-lifetime only, primitive subdomain keys; no module Map, unstable_cache, use cache directive or session-wide private reuse
readContract.freshness: Each new server request repeats current status/published reader; ten consecutive normal preset publications must render updated values. No public fallback to a status-only snapshot after published reader says absent. Private preview token/expiry/draft verification unchanged.
readContract.budget: Measure baseline first; target <=3 navigation reads (one per main/footer/policies) per isolated full document instead of repeated identical reads; mandatory store errors retain retry boundary, never false404/empty success. No hard millisecond SLA invented. Product detail <=1 identical SKU read per document; Liquid product and collection-index documents need no full catalog preload solely for a hidden React header. Actual body section/catalog/search demand remains supported.
readContract.metric: Three measured samples each of home/product/collection full document after code already loaded, same production fixture/resources/labels. Record document bytes, useful DOM readiness, scoped upstream counts/bytes/wall durations and errors; do not sum parallel durations or claim percentile population from few samples.
readContract.negative: Injected bootstrap read503 must show unavailable UI and recover next request; published preset changes prove no cross-request mapped-store retention. Existing tenant, preview, image, variant, COD and buyer lifecycle controls retained. Inject product-detail503 too; next-request recovery and normal search/variant/COD journey must remain real.

sources.consequence: One stable cached function reused across Server Components; invalidated per server request, not a global object cache.
Keep persistent data cache separate from request memoization. Test production build; dev behavior is not acceptance.
